text: The coffee, the milk and the cup cost about one dollar twenty.
asr: The coffee, the milk, and the cup cost about $1.20.

text: So the café keeps almost four dollars?
Every month, it sells thirty thousand dollars of drinks and food.
Thirty percent goes to coffee, milk and cups.
Another thirty percent pays the staff.
Power, marketing, insurance and supplies take a little more.
say: Power marketing insurance and supplies take a little more.

text: About nineteen percent, in a well-run café.
On a five-dollar latte, that is roughly ninety-five cents.
asr: On a $5 latte, that is roughly $0.95.

text: Most cafés aim for ten to fifteen percent.
Every cup pays a little toward the staff, the rent and the lights.
So the profit is not in one drink.
It is in selling two hundred of them a day.
